params.prompt: Using the approved Index Vaults environment as shared Archive rendering grammar, the Intake Tram as Stage 1 identity, and the three fighters as style/readability anchors, create the FAR BACKDROP BAND for Intake Boulevard, a 2.5D belt-scroll fighting stage outside the Living Archive outer gates. Wide flat side-on lateral composition: monumental warm-porcelain record gatehouses, deep-indigo intake towers, broad suspended archive conduits, distant stacked catalog silhouettes, sparse cyan/violet route lights and restrained amber windows. Controlled dark ink contours, broad anime cel-shaded planes, simplified distant detail, low contrast behind fighters. Unique civic Archive architecture, not a generic cyberpunk city. No floor, foreground rail, characters, human faces, billboards, readable text, props, hazards, one-point corridor, photoreal materials, rust, or dense greebles. Full-bleed 21:9 backdrop band.
